# Quench from 5000K to 1500K at 3.5 K/ps under NPT

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data /results/6_Nov_Optimised/claude_45/tool_calling/quenching/subtask_true/level_2/brief/sio2_quenching_2_subtask_structure_retrieval_trial_2/structure.data

# Define potential
pair_style tersoff
pair_coeff * * /potentials/TERSOFF/2007_SiO.tersoff Si O

# Neighbor settings
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Timestep
timestep 0.001

# NPT ensemble setup
# Quenching from 5000K to 1500K over 1000 ps (3500K / 3.5 K/ps)
# Tdamp = 100*dt = 0.1 ps, Pdamp = 1000*dt = 1.0 ps

fix npt_quench all npt temp 5000 1500 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

# Thermo output
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# Run quenching simulation
# 1000 ps = 1,000,000 steps with dt=0.001 ps
run 1000000

# Write final structure
write_data final_structure.data
"}
